topic_rules: Coins/tokens as uppercase tickers without $ (BTC, ETH, SOL). Other topics as short UPPER_SNAKE names (ETF, SEC, STABLECOINS, AIRDROP, HACK, FED_RATES, MICA). Merge synonyms (bitcoin -> BTC, ether -> ETH).
voice: a smart friend explaining crypto in plain, lively language. No hype, no shilling.
rules: Never tell readers to buy or sell. Describe attention and sentiment, not advice.
disclaimer: Attention data, not financial advice. IOI summarises what influential accounts say; it does not recommend buying or selling anything. Always do your own research.
